mapper.insert: insert into T_MDM_WORK_CALENDAR(FACTORY_CODE, PROC_CODE, YEAR, MONTH, DAY, PRODUCTION_DATE, ONE_SHIFT_FLAG, TWO_SHIFT_FLAG, THREE_SHIFT_FLAG, DAY_FLAG, RATE CREATE_TIME, CREATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY) select #{targetFactoryCode}, #{targetProcCode}, #{targetYear}, #{targetMonth}, `DAY`, STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{targetYear}, '-', #{targetMonth}, '-', `DAY`), '%Y-%m-%d'), ONE_SHIFT_FLAG, TWO_SHIFT_FLAG, THREE_SHIFT_FLAG, DAY_FLAG, RATE, now(), #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy} from T_MDM_WORK_CALENDAR where IS_DELETE = 0 AND FACTORY_CODE = #{sourceFactoryCode} and `YEAR` = #{sourceYear} and `MONTH` = #{sourceMonth} and PROC_CODE = #{sourceProcCode}
